standard.title: Methods for Grading and Classification of Muscovite Mica Blocks, Thins and Films (First Revision) (मस्कोवाइट अभ्रक ब्लॉकों, थिन और फिल्मों के ग्रेडिंग और वर्गीकरण के लिए तरीके (पहला पुनरीक्षण))
standard.description: This Indian Standard prescribes the methods for grading and visual classification of muscovite mica blocks, thins, and films based on their size, thickness, and visual quality traits to govern commercial grading, electrical component sorting, and industrial trade.
standard.scope: This Indian Standard prescribes the methods for grading and visual classification of muscovite mica blocks, thins, and films based on their size, thickness, and visual quality traits to govern commercial grading, electrical component sorting, and industrial trade.

certification.description: Voluntary Quality Grading Standard. Muscovite mica blocks, thins, and films are visually graded and sorted in processing yards prior to electrical fabrication or export based on these criteria.
requirements: Quality classification is highly subjective, carried out manually by individual workers, and heavily influenced by circumstantial factors such as lighting conditions and the inspector's mood. Thus, the standard can give at best an approximate idea of a particular quality's relative position.
Visual classification guidelines specified in this standard may or may not have any direct bearings on the actual functional end use of the mica.

Establishes unified symbols to evaluate permissible defect levels: x = Not Permissible, v = Very Slight, p = Permissible, s = Slight, l = Limited Extent, h = Heavy, and Blank Indication = Not Applicable.
Classifies the highest-tier commercial block size using the designation '250 / (SPECIAL)'.
Establishes numerical size and thickness grading benchmarks: No. 1 (160 - 10), No. 2 (100), 63, No. 3 (40), No. 4 (5), 5 V, and No. 5 (0.6) to classify structural area and thickness boundaries.
